confirmed_source_defects: No explicit read-only mode; default execution would attempt a permission POST.

Workspace and conversation were not checked against the exact admitted scope.
Owner-wide lists can miss the exact object through pagination and collect unrelated content.
STOP results did not reliably produce a nonzero exit code.
Login request hash unnecessarily incorporated a password and must not be persisted.
